sourceContract.note: D09-14 has a distinct unit/action lifecycle, but most parent observations overlap D09-13/D10/D11. Therefore evidence must be lineage-linked and cannot create an independent vote merely by restating the same share/capacity observation.

divergentStateCases.D0914: issuer loses share or delays/abandons strategic investment
divergentStateCases.reasonDistinct: industry structure favorable does not imply every issuer executes well

divergentStateCases.D0914: issuer gains share through cost, technology, product mix or customer qualification
divergentStateCases.reasonDistinct: firm competitive move can improve relative position without changing industry structure

divergentStateCases.D0914: issuer announces/implements capacity preemption, alliance, acquisition, vertical integration or new product-node positioning
divergentStateCases.reasonDistinct: dynamic strategic action can change before industry-level structure moves

antiDoubleCountRules: Market share, capacity, price, margin, customer and supplier observations have one parent evidence receipt; D09-13 and D09-14 may reference but never cast two independent Alpha votes.
D09-14 firm action is independent only if action lifecycle and actor-specific implementation fields add information beyond the D09-13 industry state.
D10 owns physical supply-chain/capacity transmission; D11/D17 own event/news timing. D09-14 may reference these receipts but cannot duplicate them.
If no firm-specific action field is present, the observation belongs only to D09-13.
Market-share level is D09-13 structure; market-share change attributable to a documented firm action may be a D09-14 outcome, not a separate simultaneous factor.

capabilityInventory.currentRepoEvidence: Search found D09-14 only in curriculum/governance/research artifacts; no Production/runtime/API/UI consumer depends on the ID.
capabilityInventory.preservationIfLaterMerged: BR-050 semantics and future firm-action receipts must remain addressable as named child capabilities under any surviving module.

classificationRationale: Current curriculum scopes overlap materially, so unrestricted KEEP_SEPARATE would duplicate evidence.
However three legitimate divergent states exist if D09-14 is narrowed to longitudinal issuer-specific strategic actions with its own action lifecycle and unit of analysis.
Most source families remain shared and D09-14 has no standalone runtime capability today, so full independent-factor treatment is not justified.
SCOPE_DEDUP_ONLY preserves the useful industry-vs-firm distinction while preventing duplicate evidence weighting.

maturityImplication.D0914: requires firm-action PIT/replay evidence; cannot inherit D09-13 maturity
